# Settings reference

The 24 app settings, read from `src/lib/stores/settings.ts`. They are saved in the browser's local storage on whichever device you use (a desktop window and a phone each keep their own). Long default values (the prompts) are shown as `(text)`.

| Setting | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `theme` | `Theme` | `'dark'` | Colour theme: `dark`, `light`, or `system` (follow the operating system). |
| `fontSize` | `string` | `'Medium'` | Interface text size: `Small`, `Medium` or `Large`. |
| `streamingEnabled` | `boolean` | `true` | Show replies word by word as they are generated instead of all at once. |
| `showThinking` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether to show the collapsible "Thinking" section for reasoning-model chain-of-thought. When off, reasoning is discarded from the UI entirely. |
| `autoGenerateImages` | `boolean` | `true` | Generate a scene image automatically when the scene changes (needs an image provider). |
| `allowMatureContent` | `boolean` | `true` | Sent as AI Horde's `nsfw` request flag for scene generation — NOT "make everything explicit," but "don't route through the safety filter that censors anything a worker's classifier flags as NSFW-ish." Defaults on since ordinary (non-explicit) roleplay character descriptions routinely brush that classifier's threshold and get false-positive blocked. |
| `autoGenerateNpcPortraits` | `boolean` | `true` | Auto-generates a portrait for each auto-detected NPC via the configured image provider. A no-op if no image provider is configured. |
| `autoApproveNpcPortraits` | `boolean` | `false` | When on, an auto-generated NPC portrait is used immediately; when off, it sits in a pending-review state until approved/regenerated/rejected. |
| `autoSaveMemories` | `boolean` | `false` | Extract facts from the conversation and save them as memories automatically. |
| `localStorageOnly` | `boolean` | `true` | Privacy mode: nothing leaves the device except calls to your chosen AI providers. |
| `ttsEnabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Master switch for voice output. Off by default — TTS must be opt-in, never autoplay for a user who hasn't explicitly turned it on. |
| `onboardingDone` | `boolean` | `false` | True once the first-run setup guide has been finished or skipped. |
| `ttsDefaultVoiceId` | `string \| null` | `null` | Fallback voice used for a character with no `voice_id` of their own. |
| `ttsDefaultProviderId` | `string \| null` | `null` | Which TTS provider `ttsDefaultVoiceId` belongs to — `null` means the built-in Kokoro engine (unchanged default), a `ProviderConfig` id means a cloud provider instead (see issue #78). |
| `systemPrompt` | `string` | `(text)` | The app-wide instructions that frame every roleplay generation (editable under Settings, Prompts). |
| `postHistoryInstructions` | `string` | `(text)` | Post-History Instructions — injected AFTER conversation history, before generation. Shapes how the AI ends responses (narrative hooks, pacing, tone). |
| `profileRefreshPrompt` | `string` | `(text)` | System instructions for the "Refresh from Story" character-profile refinement pass (manual button + automatic still-placeholder trigger). Must keep the response contract intact — the app parses the model's reply as JSON with exactly `description`/`personality`/`scenario` fields, so an edit that drops that instruction will break refreshes. |
| `maxContextTokens` | `number` | `16384` | Maximum context window size in tokens. Should match the model's limit. |
| `autoSummarize` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether to auto-generate rolling summaries of evicted messages. |
| `ragEnabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether vector RAG (semantic memory) is enabled. |
| `ragEmbeddingModel` | `string` | `'openai/text-embedding-3-small'` | Embedding model to use for RAG. |
| `ragTopK` | `number` | `5` | Number of top results to retrieve from vector search. |
| `ragMinSimilarity` | `number` | `0.7` | Minimum cosine similarity threshold for RAG results. |
| `_settingsVersion` | `number` | `CURRENT_SETTINGS_VERSION` | Internal version counter — bumped when managed defaults (PHI, systemPrompt) change. When saved version < current version, stale prompts are refreshed automatically. |
